draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row '(default)' overlaid with the frontage row: The Max A. Mayer house (Burnham & Root, 1888): the register's 'ogee gable with finial, two attic lights, tall chimneys' on a narrow party-wall front, drawn as the kit's shaped street gable over the 2½B brick body, two bays wide. Its ogee curve, carved frieze and bowed window group are T-1913's and T-1914's; the draft keeps only the silhouette. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 1339250492 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
